title: Mis-prompt: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Proactive Error Handling
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for proactive error handling in LLMs, focusing on identifying and correcting linguistic, factual, and logical errors in user prompts. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics beyond a standard 'Ethical Statement' regarding data collection and participant treatment.
